Hear from school IT administrators on how Samsung Education Portal simplifies account management, display enrollment, and Emergency Alert distribution through integrations with platforms like InformaCast and Raptor.

snippet.title: Super Steady Video | Galaxy Z Flip8 | Samsung
snippet.description:
Experience the ultimate stability of a camcorder grip with Super Steady Video on the Galaxy Z Flip8. 

Unshakable and ready for action, the new Horizontal Lock keeps your footage perfectly level. Learn more: http://smsng.co/ZFlip8_CXP_Film_FlexCam_yt

Q: What colors does Galaxy Z Flip8 come in?
A: Galaxy Z Flip8 comes in a set of premium color options for you to choose from, depending on your taste. These include Pink, Graphite, and Cream. We also offer a samsung.com only color in Mint, which is exclusively for customers who purchase on our site.
Q: What are the key features of Galaxy Z Flip8?
A: It is our lightest and thinnest Flip ever at 180 grams and 6.1 millimeters. The advanced camera system delivers a DSLR-like shooting experience, thanks to an AI-powered bokeh effect, shake-free videos with Super Steady, and quick and easy editing with Galaxy AI features like Photo Assist. The powerful Exynos 2600 processor is customized especially for Galaxy with improved NPU, GPU, and CPU for smoother graphics.
Q: How does Galaxy Z Flip8 help me effortlessly create content?
A: Galaxy Z Flip8 has new video features that help you effortlessly capture the moment. Super Steady's Horizontal Lock feature is designed to keep the camera level and stable, so you can capture smooth footage even while moving. Dual Recording allows you to record two videos simultaneously, so you can keep an eye on both sides without switching screens, giving you a different way to capture moments.

snippet.title: Galaxy AI | My FanCam | Galaxy Z Fold8 | Samsung
snippet.description:
Just film it, then reframe your favorite views later with the all-new Galaxy Z Fold8.

My FanCam takes a group video and lets you choose who gets the spotlight, in perfectly framed video clips in the ratio you want. No more stressing about capturing the perfect view of everyone in the moment. Just capture the memory and frame your favorite views later so everyone can be a star. Learn more: http://smsng.co/ZFold8_MyFanCam_yt

Q: How do I use My FanCam to reframe videos on the all-new Galaxy Z Fold8?
A: My FanCam is easy to use. Tap the 'Galaxy AI' button when viewing a video to find and activate the My FanCam editing feature. It automatically detects subjects to spotlight and offers a wide range of video ratio options for reframing. Availability may vary by video. Not supported if there is no subject to track. Accuracy of results is not guaranteed. My FanCam feature requires a Samsung Account login.

snippet.title: Galaxy AI | Now Nudge: Side-by-Side | Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra | Samsung
snippet.description:
Two apps side-by-side on the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra is now as simple as a tap. Now Nudge with Galaxy AI understands the context of your screen and suggests your next action—like checking your calendar to finalize travel plans. No more switching windows, just getting things done with ease, all at once. Learn more: http://smsng.co/ZFold8Ultra_CXPFilm-SideBySide_yt

Q: What is the Now Nudge feature on the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra?
A: Now Nudge is a new feature that recognizes screen context to provide intelligent shortcuts. Whether it's mapping out a location, adding a 'Calendar' event, or suggesting to view 'Calendar' in side-by-side split view on the large screen, it makes your Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra experience effortless.
Q: Which messaging apps are supported by Now Nudge?
A: Text message prompts are currently available with Samsung Messages and certain third-party messaging apps including Google Messages and Google Chat. Based on availability at the time of product launch. May change without notice.

snippet.title: How to monitor your body signals with Vitals | Galaxy Watch9 | Samsung
snippet.description:
Stay in tune with your body—just by wearing the Galaxy Watch9.

With Galaxy Watch, Vitals works in the background while you sleep, tracking key body signals to help you understand how your body changes over time.

Simply wear your Galaxy Watch to bed and discover subtle changes in your body's signals that you might not notice on your own, along with personalized insights that help you better understand your overall health and wellness.

In this official video guide, learn how to set up and use Vitals to monitor your heart rate, blood oxygen, skin temperature, and more. Better understand changes in your health with personalized insights. Learn more: http://smsng.co/Watch9_Howto_Vitals_yt 

00:00 Intro
00:19 Explore your Vitals
01:17 Build your baseline
02:11 Monitor your insights

Follow these steps to monitor your body signals with Vitals on Galaxy Watch9.

Explore your Vitals:
Step 1: Pair Galaxy Watch9 with your phone.
Step 2: Open Vitals in the Samsung Health app.
Step 3: Explore the 5 key health metrics tracked while you sleep.
Step 4: Tap 'About vitals' for more details and guidance.

Build your baseline:
Step 1: Open the Samsung Health app on your watch.
Step 2: Go to Settings and then Sleep.
Step 3: Turn on Blood oxygen and Skin temperature.
Step 4: Wear your Galaxy Watch9 while you sleep.
Step 5: Continue wearing your Galaxy Watch9 for at least 7 nights to build your personal baseline.

Monitor your insights:
Step 1: Open Vitals after your personal baseline is established.
Step 2: Review your health insights.
Step 3: Check metrics outside your usual range.
Step 4: Tap Vitals out of range to review overall trends.
Step 5: Tap Compare data to compare each metric against your baseline.

Q: What is Vitals on Galaxy Watch9?
A: Vitals tracks key health metrics during sleep and compares them against your personal baseline to help you stay informed about changes in your body.
Q: What metrics does Vitals track?
A: Vitals tracks Heart rate, Heart rate variability, Respiratory rate, Skin temperature, and Blood oxygen.
Q: What happens when unusual patterns are detected?
A: Vitals compares your metrics against your baseline and provides additional details and helpful guidance when unusual patterns are detected.

#GalaxyAI #GalaxyWatch9 #Samsung

snippet.title: How to sleep for a better tomorrow | Galaxy Watch9 | Samsung
snippet.description:
Better sleep leads to a better tomorrow.

With Galaxy Watch, you can manage every stage of your sleep journey—from building better bedtime habits, to understanding your sleep and preparing for the day ahead. Simply wear your Galaxy Watch to bed and receive personalized insights that help you stay in tune with your sleep and overall wellness.

In this official video guide, learn how Galaxy Watch brings together Bedtime Guidance, Sleep Apnea, and Energy Score to give you a more complete overview of your sleep-from night to day. Learn more: http://smsng.co/Watch9_Howto_BetterSleep_yt

00:00 Intro
00:20 Bedtime Guidance
01:14 Sleep Apnea
02:38 Energy Score

Follow these steps to manage your sleep journey with Galaxy Watch. 

Bedtime Guidance:
Step 1: Pair your Galaxy Watch with your phone.
Step 2: Wear for 3 nights to personalize Bedtime Guidance.
Step 3: Open the Samsung Health app and set up Bedtime Guidance.
Step 4: Set your target wake-up time and enable Bedtime notifications.

Sleep Apnea:
Step 1: Install Samsung Health Monitor on both your phone and Galaxy Watch.
Step 2: Set up Sleep Apnea.
Step 3: Wear your Galaxy Watch for 2 nights and check for signs of sleep apnea.

Energy Score:
Step 1: Wear your Galaxy Watch while you sleep to get your Energy score.
Step 2: Ensure Energy score, Score factors, and Al-powered insights are on.

snippet.title: How to find balance in your training | Galaxy Watch Ultra2 | Samsung
snippet.description:
This is the official video guide to training with balance with Galaxy Watch. Finding the right balance between pushing forward and recovery helps you train at your own pace. Daily Cardio Load analyzes changes in your physical strain to help you understand when to take a break or train harder. Fitness Index provides a clear view of your fitness level based on VO₂ max, BIA, heart rate, steps, and activity data. Personalized insights and workout recommendations help you keep progressing towards your goals. With Galaxy Watch, understand your performance, find your training balance, and keep moving forward. Learn more: http://smsng.co/WatchUltra2_Fitness-Load_yt 
 
00:00 Intro
00:16 Daily Cardio Load
01:56 Fitness Index

Follow these steps to set up Daily Cardio Load and Fitness Index on Galaxy Watch Ultra2.

Setting up Daily Cardio Load:
Step 1: Swipe left on your Galaxy Watch and tap 'Add tile' to add 'Daily cardio load'.
Step 2: Tap 'Daily cardio load' from your watch face to check your training status.
Step 3: On your phone, set your Daily cardio load target based on your training goal.
Step 4: Monitor your daily activity and get insights into your training effort, recovery, and recommended intensity.

Setting up Fitness Index:
Step 1: Open the Samsung Health app on your phone and go to 'Fitness index'.
Step 2: Complete three measurements to calculate your Fitness index: body composition, a walk or run, and step tracking for two days.
Step 3: Check your Fitness index based on your physical ability and activity level.
Step 4: Follow Weekly missions with fitness content recommended based on your goals.

Q: What information does the Daily Cardio Load metric show on my Galaxy Watch?
A: Daily Cardio Load tracks the effort and intensity of your workouts over time, helping you balance training and recovery and maintain the right intensity over time.

Q: How does the Galaxy Watch calculate my Fitness index?
A: The watch calculates the Fitness index using data from its built-in health sensors and training load information. This calculation combines your daily activity and workout intensity. The result gives you a single score that reflects your overall fitness level, helping you track your progress over time.

Running Coach is available across the Galaxy Watch and helps you find the right place to begin based on your running history or a quick level test. From there, it guides you with a personalized training plan. When you're ready for the trail, Trail Run is available only on Galaxy Watch Ultra2. Route Navigation, Climb Guidance, and Water Intake Alarm guide you safely from the first step to the last mile. With Galaxy Watch Ultra2, be ready for every run, from finding your level to reaching your next milestone. Learn more:
http://smsng.co/WatchUltra2_Running-Trail_yt
 
00:00 Intro
00:17 Running Coach
02:21 Trail Run

Follow these steps to get started with Running Coach and Trail Run features on Galaxy Watch Ultra2.

Using Running Coach:
Step 1: Open Running Coach and complete your profile.
Step 2: Find your running level by taking the level test or using your previous running history.
Step 3: Review your assigned running level and start your personalized training plan.
Step 4: Complete your scheduled training sessions to build progress.
Step 5: Take the level up test when prompted to unlock your next running level.

Preparing for Trail Run:
Step 1: Import a GPX route to your watch.
Step 2: Choose the device you want to use for navigation, either your watch or mobile phone.
Step 3: Set up optional features, such as Water Intake Alarm, before you start.
Step 4: Tap 'Start' to begin your Trail Run workout.
Step 5: Follow Route Navigation to stay on course and check your next checkpoint.
Step 6: Use Climb Guidance to prepare for upcoming climbs along your route.

Q: Is Galaxy Watch Ultra2 a good choice for runners?
A: Yes, tracking runs is one of Galaxy Watch Ultra2's standout capabilities. Whether you're just starting out or training for a marathon, the Running Coach builds a 3–5 week program around your ability, with guided sessions to help you develop endurance and keep pushing further. 

Q: What features are available for Trail Run?
A: Here are some key features that enhance your Trail Run experience on Galaxy Watch Ultra2.
• Route: Load a GPX file and follow your pre-planned course turn by turn, with GPS tracking your position in real time.
• Climb Guidance: Check your average gradient and elevation gain ahead of each segment, so you can manage your pace before the hill slows you down.
• Water Intake Alarm: Get timely reminders on how much water to drink and when, so you stay hydrated even when the trail has your full attention.

snippet.title: How to use FlexWindow and Now Brief | Galaxy AI | Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Fold8, and Flip8 | Samsung
snippet.description:
This is the official video guide on how to use New FlexWindow home and Now Brief with Galaxy AI. Wish you could get more done without even opening your phone? ✨ Customize your FlexWindow with your favorite apps and access them right from the cover screen. You can also personalize Now Brief with custom cards to receive hyper-personalized insights at a glance. Whether you’re checking essential apps or staying on top of your daily routine, New FlexWindow home and Now Brief helps keep your day moving smoothly. It’s recommended for users who want to boost productivity and get through their day effortlessly 🚀 Learn more: http://smsng.co/ZFlip8_FlexWindow-NowBrief_Howto_yt
 
00:00 Intro 
00:12 Customize your FlexWindow home
01:47 Create your own custom cards

Follow these easy steps to make the most of the New FlexWindow home and Now Brief:
Step 1: Customize apps on FlexWindow home. Swipe up from the lock screen, then swipe up again to open Now Brief. Long press an empty space and tap ‘Add apps’ to customize your app tray. Tap 'Back' icon to return to Now Brief. Long press on an empty space, then tap the icon for more widgets. Tap ‘Apps’ and select the Apps widget. Tap ‘Add’, then tap ‘Get started’. Choose your top 4 apps and tap ‘Done’ to conveniently access your go-to apps from FlexWindow and keep your flow going. 
Step 2: Create your own custom cards. Swipe up from the lock screen and tap ‘Start Now Brief’. Tap once more, then unfold your phone to continue. Choose your custom card and select a suggested prompt to personalize it. Check the card details and tap ‘Done’.

Q: Can I change the apps on FlexWindow later?
A: Yes. You can edit your selected apps anytime from the Apps widget settings.
Q: How many apps can I add to the App tray on FlexWindow?
A: You can choose up to 4 apps for quick access from FlexWindow.

Let's get started with Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Z Fold8, and Z Flip8. Capture even the most vibrant moments with smooth, stable video. While the level guide is on by default, you can enable Super Steady with Horizontal Lock for enhanced stability. Get steady videos on the go, and even on the run 🎥 Learn more: http://smsng.co/ZFlip8_Super-Steady-Video_Howto_yt

00:00 Intro
00:08 Film smoother videos with Super Steady with Horizontal Lock

Follow these simple steps to use Super Steady Video:
Step 1: Make sure your phone is in horizontal mode. Tap 'Camera' and switch to video mode. Find and tap the 'Super Steady with Horizontal Lock' icon to effortlessly capture steady and level videos.
Step 2: Tap 'Gallery'. Select and play the video to see how smooth it turned out with Super Steady with Horizontal Lock.

Q: How does Super Steady with Horizontal Lock keep my shots level?
A: Super Steady with Horizontal Lock uses expanded optical angles with gyro and acceleration sensors to recognize the direction of gravity to keep your shots level.
Q: Does my frame stay level even if I run while filming?
A: Yes. Super Steady with Horizontal Lock keeps your frame level and stable, even if you run or rotate the camera a full 360°.

snippet.title: How to use Smart Switch | Samsung
snippet.description:
This is the official video guide on how to use Smart Switch on Galaxy smartphones. Switching to Galaxy is easier than ever. Transfer your contacts, photos, messages, videos, and more to your new Galaxy quickly and effortlessly without installing extra apps. Move your data wirelessly, the easy way—so you can keep what you love and start fresh without starting over ✨ Perfect for anyone switching to Galaxy and looking for a quick, secure way to bring their data with them 📂 Learn more: http://smsng.co/ZFold8_Smart-Switch_Howto_yt

00:00 Intro 
00:11 Easy setup on a new Galaxy device
01:30 Smart Switch on your current Galaxy device

Follow these easy steps to transfer your data with Smart Switch:

Step 1: Get both devices ready: your old phone and your new Galaxy.
Step 2: Scan the QR code to connect your devices.
Step 3: Select the data you want to transfer.
Step 4: Let Smart Switch complete the transfer.

Q: What can be transferred with Smart Switch? (iOS to Galaxy)
A: If your old device is an iOS model, you’ll still be able to transfer data from iPhone to Galaxy including all your contacts, texts, and media files. This makes your iPhone to Galaxy migration smooth and simple. Some iOS apps may not be transferred, but Smart Switch will recommend similar apps for your new Galaxy device. See more details on what types of data Smart Switch can transfer below.
Q: Does Smart Switch delete content from the previous device?
A: No. Smart Switch does not remove any content from either device. When the transfer is completed, the data will exist on both devices.

#GalaxyAI #GalaxyZFold8 #SmartSwitch #Samsung

snippet.title: How to use Photo Assist | Galaxy AI | Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Fold8, and Flip8 | Samsung
snippet.description:
This is the official guide on how to use Photo Assist with Galaxy AI. Want to touch up your photos with just a few words? Let's get started with Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Z Fold8, and Z Flip8 ✨ Whether you're changing the background of a portrait to stand out or adding eye-catching details to your landscape shots to make your social feed pop, everything you can imagine, you can bring to life. Simply put your imagination into words―Photo Assist will handle the rest in seconds 🦄 Learn more: http://smsng.co/ZFold8_PhotoAssist_Howto_yt 

00:00 Intro  
00:19 Edit portraits with prompts
02:00 Edit landscape photos with prompts

Follow these simple steps to change the background with Photo Assist on your Galaxy phone:
Step 1: To change the background of your photo, start by opening the 'Gallery' app. Select a photo, tap 'Galaxy AI', tap 'Create', and then tap the prompt bar.
Step 2: Type in a few words to describe how you would like to change the background of your photo. Then, tap 'Generate' to recreate the background of your image in a snap. To compare the new image with the original, simply tap 'Show previous'.

Follow these simple steps to edit landscape photos with Photo Assist on your Galaxy phone:
Step 1: To edit landscape photos using prompts, select a photo from your gallery. Tap 'Galaxy AI', 'Create', and tap on the prompt bar in order. Simply type in to describe how you would like your photo tweaked.
Step 2: Tap 'Generate' and check out your image recreated in a snap. Tap 'Show previous' to compare it with the original. To save the recreated image in your gallery, tap 'Save copy'.

Q: How can I reimagine my photos with the prompts?
A: You can use prompts for a wide range of edits, including changing the background, adding or removing objects, and changing styles.
Q: Will there be an indication that the image is AI-generated?
A: Yes. When you save the image, a visible watermark is automatically added to indicate that the image is AI-generated.

snippet.title: How to use Now Nudge | Galaxy AI | Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Fold8, and Flip8 | Samsung
snippet.description:
This is the official video guide on how to use Now Nudge with Galaxy AI. Ever wish your phone could keep up with what you’re doing? 💪 Let's get started with Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Z Fold8, and Z Flip8.

From saving your next food spot to adding plans to your calendar, Now Nudge helps you take the next step without breaking your flow. By understanding what’s on your screen, Now Nudge surfaces helpful prompts that let you jump right into your next action. Unfold to continue in Multi Window and get more done in one place. Add calendar events, save places from your chat, and keep your day moving without constantly switching between apps ⚡ Learn more: http://smsng.co/ZFold8Ultra_NowNudge_Howto_yt
 
00:00 Intro
00:17 Turn Now Nudge on or off 
00:46 Keep your chat and calendar in one view 
01:21 Save places from your chat to Google Maps

Follow these simple steps to use Now Nudge:
Step 1: Turn Now Nudge on or off. Log in to your Samsung Account and then open the Quick panel. Tap ‘Settings’ and use the toggle to turn Now Nudge on or off. By default, Now Nudge is turned on.
Step 2: Add events while texting. Now Nudge recognizes dates and time in your messages and gives you quick access to your calendar. Unfold and tap ‘Add event’ to open your calendar alongside your conversation, then add the event without leaving the chat.
Step 3: Save places from your chat to the map. Now Nudge spots places mentioned in your chat and suggests a shortcut to save them in the map. Unfold and tap ‘Save this place’ to check your chat and the map at the same time.

Q: What's Now Nudge?
A: Now Nudge is a new feature that intelligently understands what's on your screen and will provide suggestions, such as viewing your Calendar to add an event. If a suggestion from Now Nudge appears on the main screen, you will be taken to the next action in split view once pressed.
Q: Can I receive text message prompts from third-party messaging apps?
A: Yes. In addition to the Samsung Message app, Now Nudge also supports third-party messaging apps such as Google Messages and Google Chat.

snippet.title: Introducing Galaxy Watch9 | Galaxy AI | Samsung
snippet.description:
Meet Galaxy Watch9—designed to help you track and manage your health with ease. Detect risk of sleep apnea, monitor heart health and blood pressure, enjoy the perks of personalized running coach, and much more–simply all from your wrist. 

Just wear it, and let Galaxy Watch9 take care of the rest. Learn more: http://smsng.co/Watch9_Intro_yt

01:27 Running coach 
02:11 Blood pressure monitoring

Q: Can I find out if I have sleep apnea using Galaxy Watch9?
A: Yes, Watch9 can detect signs of moderate to severe sleep apnea and also provide information about breathing disruption levels.
Q: How can I measure my blood pressure using Galaxy Watch9?
A: Open the blood pressure widget, keep your arm and wrist at heart level, and stay still. After waiting for about 30 seconds, the measurement result will be displayed. For accurate blood pressure readings, a calibration is required every 4 weeks by BP monitor & arm cuff. 
Q: What is “Vitals"?
A: Galaxy Watch9 detects subtle abnormal vital signals (which are hard to catch), and predicts conditions of the day in advance. 
Q: What color options and sizes are available for the Galaxy Watch9?
A: It comes in two colors, and two size options: (Large) Graphite, Silver, (Small) Graphite, Cream

snippet.description:

A: You can customize the cover screen to match your style and do more without having to unfold the device. Customize the cover screen with widgets that seamlessly match your home screen layout. A: Galaxy Z Flip8 comes with updated Galaxy AI features that are easy and simple to use. You can enjoy fast photo editing with your own personalized prompts in Photo Assist. Now Brief now comes with buttons on certain insights that suggest actions such as creating a card for a friend's upcoming birthday.

snippet.title: HVAC Case Study: Airport (360 Cassette fan coil units) | Samsung
snippet.description:
This video shows Tulum International Airport, Mexico's newest gateway, which welcomes over one million visitors every year installing 224 Samsung 360 Cassette fan coil units throughout the terminal, providing real-time, zone-by-zone cooling control.

Q: How does Samsung 360 Cassette help manage cooling in large airport spaces?
A: Samsung 360 Cassette fan coil units provide flexible zone-by-zone cooling control, making them well suited for large public spaces with high ceilings, open layouts, and continuously changing passenger traffic. Each unit adapts precisely to shifting load conditions, ensuring efficient energy management at all times, from boarding gates to lounges.

A wired touch controller on every indoor unit enables on-site monitoring and instant adjustments. The system learns and evolves with every hour of operation.

snippet.title: Introducing Bespoke AI Refrigerator Side-by-Side | Water & Ice Dispenser | Samsung
snippet.description:
This is an official video on Bespoke AI Refrigerator with Water & Ice Dispenser. The Auto Open Door has sensors on both sides that help you open the door when you lightly touch them. Newly updated Samsung Bixby allows you to control the AI Home refrigerator’s features remotely, and even open the fridge with just your voice. AI Energy Mode reduces your energy use by up to 10% by intelligently adjusting the compressor speed and the frequency of the defrost cycle, based on your usage pattern and surroundings. Water & Ice Dispenser provides you with a glass of chilled water or provides plenty of ice to cool down your drinks, without having to open the fridge.

snippet.title: How to use Samsung Browser across your Galaxy devices | Samsung
snippet.description:
This is the official video guide on how to use Samsung Browser across your Galaxy smartphone, tablet, and PC. Looking for a smarter way to browse? Samsung Browser helps you pick up where you left off on another device and use Galaxy AI to summarize pages, translate content, and get quick answers and insights ✨ Built to make everyday browsing more streamlined and easier to manage, it’s ideal for users who want to stay in the flow and get more done across their Galaxy devices 🚀 Learn more: http://smsng.co/SamsungBrowser_HowTo_yt

00:00 Intro 
00:07 Basic setup 
00:46 Connect your devices 
02:22 Summarize & translate 
03:29 Ask anything & get answers 
04:31 Additional device setup 

Follow these steps to easily use Samsung Browser across your Galaxy devices: 

Step 1: Set up Samsung Browser. Visit browser.samsung.com to download Samsung Browser on your PC. Install and open it, then sign in with the same Samsung Account on your Galaxy smartphone, tablet, and PC. 

Step 2: Connect your devices. Turn on Bluetooth and make sure all devices are signed in with the same Samsung Account. Open a webpage on one device, then tap the webpage icon on another device to continue reading seamlessly. 

Step 3: Summarize and translate pages. Open ‘Galaxy AI’ while viewing a webpage and select ‘Summarize page’ to see key points quickly. Select ‘Translate’ to view the page in another language, or use ‘Split view’ to compare the original and translated pages side by side. 

Step 4: Ask questions and compare tabs. Open ‘Galaxy AI’ to ask questions about the page you’re viewing and get quick answers. It can also review multiple open tabs to help you compare information more easily. 

Step 5: Turn on sync. On your PC, go to 'Connected devices' and enable 'Continue on other devices'. In Samsung Browser Settings, turn on ‘Items to sync’. On your tablet and phone, enable 'Continue on other devices' and turn on ‘Sync with Samsung Cloud’ in Samsung Browser Settings. 

Q: What can Galaxy AI do in Samsung Browser? 
A: Galaxy AI in Samsung Browser can summarize webpages, translate content into another language, answer questions about the page you’re viewing, and help review multiple open tabs to make browsing more streamlined and efficient. 
Q: Do I need to sign in with a Samsung Account to use Samsung Browser across devices? 
A: Yes. Signing in with the same Samsung Account is required to sync your browsing information and use cross-device continuity features. 

#GalaxyAI #Samsung

snippet.title: Meet the Generation17 Young Leaders: The Story of José Francisco Ochoa | Samsung
snippet.description:
Generation17 Young Leader José Francisco Ochoa noticed something that couldn't be ignored: most ocean and climate science existed only in English, leaving millions of Spanish speakers out of the conversation and solutions. In 2023, he and three colleagues founded Academia del Océano—one of the first ocean education centers in Ecuador to teach entirely in Spanish. The young biologist is now training a new generation of scientists and conservationists through hands-on programs on Ecuador's Pacific coast and virtual programming, reaching students across 10 countries. Since 2023, more than 10,000 students have taken part in Academia del Océano's programs, and over 500 have earned university certifications in ocean science.

Generation17 is an initiative in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) that aims to harness technology to elevate the voices of young leaders around the globe who are working to achieve the Global Goals. Established by the United Nations in 2015, the Global Goals—or Sustainable Development Goals—provide a framework to address pressing global challenges including, poverty, inequality, climate change and peace and justice, to build a better future for all by 2030. Be part of the solution—download the Samsung Global Goals app here: http://smsng.co/Generation17_Jose_yt

#Generation17 #GlobalGoals #Samsung

snippet.title: Introducing Bespoke AI Dishwasher | Samsung
snippet.description:
Welcome to a world of effortless dishwashing!
Upgrade your kitchen routine with the Bespoke AI Dishwasher. Powered by the smart AI Wash feature, it continuously detects soil levels during the cycle and automatically customizes the settings for the optimal clean.
Need to fit drinkware, pans, and everyday dishes all at once? The 3rd Rack Washing System and FlexLoad allow for efficient space utilization, giving you the ultimate flexibility to load your dishes your way. Moreover, you can save energy with up to an A-20% energy efficiency* rating!
Experience a smarter, more convenient dishwashing life with Bespoke AI.
Enabling timeful living.

*Energy ratings may vary depending on the model. Product features may differ by model.

Q. Do I need to pre-wash my dishes before using the dishwasher?
A. Samsung dishwashers provide powerful cleaning from all angles. Especially for models equipped with a rotating dual wash arm, two spray arms spray water in different directions to thoroughly clean contaminants such as grease and high-concentration contaminants. However, if the contaminants are large or hardened, you can pre-wash them to clean items more thoroughly. Make the most of your dishwasher’s cleaning function by pre-washing as needed.

snippet.title: Introducing Samsung Extractor Induction Hob | Samsung
snippet.description:
This is the official video guide on the Samsung Extractor Induction Hob.

Enhance your kitchen experience with a seamless design that combines powerful ventilation and versatile cooking. The Extractor Induction Hob features a durable Anti-Scratch Glass (Mohs hardness 8 vs. general ceramic glass's 5), powerful High Suction Power (720 m³/h) with A+ energy efficiency* to keep your kitchen fresh, and an Easy-Clean Grease Filter for simple maintenance. Its flexible cooking zones and flush-fit design free up your kitchen space for open living, blending style and functionality perfectly.

Learn more: http://www.samsung.com/bespoke-home

00:04 Anti-Scratch Glass
00:30 High Suction Power
00:47 Easy-Clean Grease Filter

Q. How does the Anti-Scratch Glass differ from regular cooktop glass?
A. It features high durability. Based on Intertek testing (ASTM C1895), Samsung's Anti-Scratch Glass has an verified Mohs hardness rating of 8, compared to 5 for general ceramic glass.

Q. How does the integrated system achieve an A+ energy rating without compromising performance?
A. Through optimized engineering. The high-efficiency motor delivers powerful suction of up to 720 m³/h while minimizing power consumption, maintaining both performance and energy efficiency.

Q. What makes the grease filter easy to clean?
A. The durable stainless steel grease filter is designed to be easily detachable and is dishwasher-safe, ensuring simple maintenance.

This is the official video introducing the WindFree™ Wearable Good Sleep feature of the Bespoke AI WindFree, Samsung's new 2026 room air conditioner.

Enjoy a really good night’s sleep every night. The WindFree™ Wearable Good Sleep mode is linked to wearable smart devices, such as the Galaxy Watch and Ring. When they detect that you are asleep, the system automatically turns on WindFree™ Cooling and adjusts the cooling performance to suit your sleep pattern and create the ideal climate for a deep and pleasant sleep throughout the night.

snippet.title: How to get the best fit with your Galaxy Buds | Galaxy Buds4 Series | Samsung
snippet.description:
This is the official video guide to wearing your Galaxy Buds4 Series for the perfect fit and optimal sound quality. Whether you’re using Galaxy Buds4 or Galaxy Buds4 Pro, learn how to insert them correctly and get the most out of your audio. Discover the right blade angle for clear voice pickup and how to choose the best ear tip size (S, M, or L) for a secure, comfortable fit—even on the move. Learn more: http://smsng.co/Buds4Series_BestFit_yt

00:00 Intro
00:19 Proper fit
01:01 Ear tip replacement

Follow these steps to get the right fit with Galaxy Buds4 Series:

Wearing the earbuds 
Step 1: Lift the earbuds straight up from the charging case. 
Step 2: Check the L/R marks and place them in the matching ear. 
Step 3: Point the blade toward your mouth and rotate slightly until snug. 
Step 4: Listen for the sound feedback to confirm they are in the right position. 

Replacing the ear tips (Galaxy Buds4 Pro) 
Step 1: Roll the ear tip inside out and pull it straight off.
Step 2: Select the size (S, M, or L) that feels most comfortable. 
Step 3: Align the notch with the groove and push until it clicks. 
Step 4: Run a fit test to verify the seal.

Q: How do I know if I’m wearing the earbuds correctly?
A: When inserted at the right angle with the blade pointing toward your mouth, your Galaxy Buds4 Series will provide sound feedback to confirm they are detected.
Q: How do I clean my Galaxy Buds4 Series earbuds?
A: Use a soft, dry cloth to gently clean the earbuds after use. Clean them regularly to prevent earwax or debris from building up in the microphone, speaker, and air duct.
Q: How often should I change my ear tips?
A: Check your ear tips regularly for wear and tear. If the earbuds feel loose or sound quality decreases, switch to a different size or replace them to maintain a secure and hygienic fit.

#GalaxyBuds4Pro #GalaxyBuds4 #EarTipReplacement #Samsung

snippet.title: How to locate earbuds with SmartThings | Galaxy Buds4 Series | Samsung
snippet.description:
Lost your Galaxy Buds4 Series? Locate them in seconds using the SmartThings app. This official guide shows you how to quickly track and find your earbuds right from your smartphone.

Learn how to use real-time tracking and audible alerts to pinpoint their location, so you can spend less time searching and more time listening. Stay connected and in control with Galaxy Buds4 or Galaxy Buds4 Pro, and find them whenever you need. Learn more: http://smsng.co/GalaxyBuds4_SmartThings_yt

00:00 Intro
00:17 SmartThings setup
00:51 Earbud location tracking

SmartThings setup
Step 1: Download the SmartThings app from the Samsung Galaxy Store.
Step 2: Ensure your Galaxy Buds4 Series is registered to your account.
Step 3: Tap 'Find' in the app to view your device.

Tracking your earbuds
Step 1: Open the charging case.
Step 2: View the map to see the current or last known location.
Step 3: Select 'Ring' to make your earbuds play a sound.
Step 4: Follow the sound to recover your device.

Q. Where can I download the SmartThings app?
A. SmartThings is available on the Samsung Galaxy Store. Once installed, it allows you to connect, control, and track your registered Galaxy devices in one place.
Q. What is the fastest way to find my earbuds nearby?
A. After using the map to get close, select 'Ring'. Your earbuds will play a sound to help you locate them quickly.
Q. Can I find my earbuds if one is missing?
A. When the charging case is open, the earbud inside is detected. You can then check the location of the missing earbud on the map.

#GalaxyBuds4Pro #GalaxyBuds4 #SmartThings #Samsung

snippet.title: Smart Comfort, Always Fresh｜Freeze Wash (Bespoke AI WindFree)｜Samsung
snippet.description:
This is the official video introducing the Freeze Wash feature of the Bespoke AI WindFree, Samsung's new room air conditioner.

Keep your AC clean & hygienic–easy maintenance without the help of a professional. Freeze Wash quickly freezes and then defrosts the heat exchanger. So it is washed in water, which removes dirt and contamination, including 95% of microorganisms. Finally, it dries up any moisture. Also, it alerts you when it is time for cleaning.

So, how does it work?
Step 1: Freeze the heat exchanger of the indoor unit.  
Step 2: The wind blows in to melt the ice. A lot of water is created, and pollutants in the heat exchanger are washed away.
Step 3: Dry up any moisture left on the heat exchanger   

Q. How can I turn on Freeze Wash? 
A: Turn off the AC, press the “Options” button on the remote controller, and select "Wash". Or you can turn it on using SmartThings on your phone.

#FreezeWash #CleaningAC #CleanHeatExchanger #EasyMaintenance #Maintenance #EasyCare #BespokeAIWindFree #SmartComfort #AlwaysFresh #BespokeAI #Samsung

snippet.title: Smart Comfort, Always Fresh｜3-step Auto Clean (Bespoke AI WindFree)｜Samsung
snippet.description:
This is the official video introducing the 3-step Auto Clean feature of the Bespoke AI WindFree, Samsung's new room air conditioner.

Sit back and enjoy the comfort of easy maintenance! After use, an Auto Clean function automatically dries  the heat exchanger using a 3-step process. It removes moisture inside by blowing air for 10–30 minutes. So it helps prevent the buildup of bacteria & odors.

So, how does it work?
Step 1: Initially, it blows air for 10 minutes to remove moisture inside the AC.
Step 2: After checking internal humidity and temperature, it proceeds with the Auto Clean process using WindFree™ for 10 minutes.
Step 3: It checks humidity and temperature once more and continues for another 10 minutes of WindFree™ if necessary.

Q. How can I turn on 3-step Auto Clean?
A: To activate Auto Clean, press the “Options” button on the remote for at least 3 seconds, or you can turn it on using SmartThings on your phone.

#3StepAutoClean #ACAutoClean #CleaningAC #EasyMaintenance #EasyCare #BespokeAIWindFree #AirConditioner #SmartComfort #AlwaysFresh #BespokeAI #Samsung

snippet.title: Samsung Slide-in Range Pro Style Design
snippet.description:
This is the official video guide on the Samsung Slide-in Range with Pro Style Design.

Experience a perfect balance of style, functionality, and innovation with the Samsung Slide-in Range. Featuring a polished stainless steel finish and the refined handle, it delivers a modern, professional look that blends seamlessly into any kitchen.

Intuitive controls and LED-backlit touch buttons improve visibility and ease of use for a more precise cooking experience.

With Air Fry Max, enjoy fast, crispy results without preheating. Enhanced heating technology air-fries up to 15% faster¹, helping you enjoy healthier² meals with less effort. 
(¹Compared to tests of common air fried foods vs. Air Fry mode on select Samsung models. Results may vary. ²As compared to deep frying.)

Learn more: http://www.samsung.com/bespoke-home

00:29 Air Fry Max

Q. What makes Pro Style Design special?
A. Pro Style Design features a premium stainless steel finish and refined handles for a modern, professional kitchen look. It is designed to blend seamlessly into contemporary kitchen interiors.

Q. What are Illuminated Knobs?
A. Illuminated Precision Knobs light up when the cooktop is on, providing clear visual feedback. This helps users easily see burner status and cook with greater confidence.

Q. What is Air Fry Max?
A. Air Fry Max delivers fast, crispy results without preheating, using enhanced heating technology. It air-fries up to 15% faster¹ for easier, healthier² meals. 
(¹Compared to tests of common air fried foods vs. Air Fry mode on select Samsung models. Results may vary. ²As compared to deep frying.)

Q. What is the Soft Close Door?
A. The Soft Close Door allows the oven to close smoothly and quietly with minimal effort. It adds everyday convenience and a more premium user experience.

snippet.description:
This is an official video guide on introducing Bespoke AI Refrigerator FDR Auto View. 

See inside effortlessly without opening the doors. Auto View is a transparent door that welcomes lighting automatically, and gradually turns on when you are near.

The distance to activate the welcome lighting can be selected from 4 options. In comparision with conventional models, Zero clerance fit models enable to open the door up to 108° even in tight space. This Bespoke AI refrigerator offers 4 types of ice - sphere/ half sphere/ curved/ crushed. Experience the convenient and premium life

① Intro - 00:00~00:02 
② Auto View - 00:02~00:12 
③ Zero clearance fit - 00:13~00:44
④ 4 types of ice - 00:45~01:04 
⑤ Tall water and ice dispenser - 01:05~01:20 
⑥ Outro - 01:21~01:32 

Q. What is Auto View?
A. Auto View is a transparent door that welcomes lighting automatically, and gradually turns on when you are near, so that you can see what is inside without opening a door

Q. What is the condition to install Zero clearance fit refrigerator?
A. Minimum required installation space for a custom built-in setup: [Width] 916 mm or more (Ensure a minimum gap of 4 mm on the left/right sides), [Height] 1798 mm or more (Ensure a minimum gap of 20 mm at the top).

Q. Which types of ice the refrigerator provides?
A. It offers four ice shapes—Sphere, Half Sphere, Curved, or Crushed—to perfectly match your drink of the day.

This is an official video guide to the Samsung Bespoke AI Single Door Fridge & Freezer, featuring Auto Open Door, AI Precise Cooling, Metal Cooling, Full Flex Convertible, and AI Energy Mode.

Discover how intelligent cooling, flexible storage, and AI-powered energy saving help keep your food fresher for longer while making everyday life more convenient.

A. Auto Open Door lets you open the refrigerator with a light touch, making it easier to access your food when your hands are full.

Q. How does AI Precise Cooling help keep food fresh?
A. AI Precise Cooling analyses your usage patterns and adjusts the defrost cycle to help minimise temperature fluctuations, keeping food fresher for longer.

Q. What is Full Flex Convertible?
A. Full Flex Convertible offers four flexible modes, allowing you to switch between refrigerator and freezer settings to suit your storage needs.

Q. How does AI Energy Mode work?
A. AI Energy Mode works with SmartThings Energy to intelligently adjust the compressor speed and defrost cycle based on your usage patterns, helping improve energy efficiency.

snippet.title: Meet the Generation17 Young Leaders: The Story of Brigitta Maria Andrea Gunawan | Samsung
snippet.description:
Generation17 Young Leader Brigitta Gunawan is racing to save Indonesia's coral reefs before it's too late. Scientists warn that up to 90 % of coral reefs could be gone by 2050, so Brigitta is fighting back. The young marine conservationist leads two organizations—30x30 Indonesia and Diverseas—taking a dual approach to ocean conservation. Through 30x30 Indonesia, she's restoring coral reefs one fragment at a time, planting over 1,400 corals at underwater gardens in Bali. Through Diverseas, she's bringing the ocean to people who've never seen it, using VR headsets and 360-degree underwater films to inspire the next generation of ocean advocates. Her efforts have reached more than 20,000 people across 20 countries. 

Generation17 is an initiative in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (@UNDP) that aims to harness technology to elevate the voices of young leaders around the globe who are working to achieve the Global Goals. Established by the United Nations in 2015, the Global Goals—or Sustainable Development Goals—provide a framework to address pressing global challenges including poverty, inequality, climate change and peace and justice, to build a better future for all by 2030. 

Be part of the solution—download the Samsung Global Goals app here: http://smsng.co/Gen17_Brigitta_SGG_yt

snippet.title: How to use AI Select | Galaxy AI | Galaxy S26 Series | Samsung
snippet.description:
This is the official video guide on how to use AI Select on Galaxy S26 Series. Wish you could get instant help right from your phone screen? 🤩 AI Select analyzes your screen and intelligently gives a quick suggestion for your next step. Whether you’re saving plans to your calendar or rewinding a clip and editing the best moment, AI Select helps you to get things done in a tap. It’s recommended for users who want to boost productivity and get things done right from their screen, without having to juggle between different apps 🚀 Learn more: http://smsng.co/S26_AI-Select_How-to_yt

00:00 Intro 
00:13 Add plans to the calendar
00:59 Rewind key moments and edit

Follow these steps to make the most of AI Select:
Step 1: If you get a confirmation email for reservations, tap the email notification. Long press the Edge panel to enable AI Select and select the part you need help on. 
Step 2: AI Select will recognize the details of the reservation and will prompt you to tap ‘Add event’. The details will be already filled in your calendar. Then tap ‘Save’ to add events to the calendar conveniently.
Step 3: If you want to capture a certain moment while watching a clip, long press the Edge panel. Tap ‘Rewind’ and then tap ‘Thumbnail’ to capture the best moments effortlessly.
Step 4: To edit the scene you saved, select the part you want to adjust. Tap ‘Photo assist’ and draw around the object you want to remove. Check the selected area and tap ‘Eraser’. Finally, tap ‘Save’ to enjoy the moment exactly the way you want.

Q: How can I access AI Select on Galaxy S26 Series?
A: There are two easy ways to access AI Select on Galaxy S26 Series. Long press the Edge panel and select what’s on your screen to access AI Select. You can also swipe the Edge panel and then tap ‘AI select’ to use AI Select.
Q: What types of content can I use AI Select with?
A: AI Select works across images, videos, and text. You can select an area to edit, save, share or extract text.

#GalaxyAI #GalaxyS26Ultra #GalaxyS26 #Samsung

snippet.description:
The world’s first Privacy Display on mobile. Meet your built-in privacy screen, only on Galaxy S26 Ultra. Laughing at a video with friends when a sweet message from your girlfriend appears? Just turn on Privacy Display to keep that moment just between the two of you. Simply choose what and when to share with Privacy Display. Learn more: http://smsng.co/S26Ultra_Privacy-Display_yt

Q: What is Privacy Display, and how does it work?
A: Privacy Display is a built-in privacy screen that uses innovative technology to protect your device's display from prying eyes in public places. When activated, the screen's pixels move dynamically to keep the display visible when you look at it straight on, but then appear dimmed when seen from the side by the people around you. You can have the full screen hidden from view, or choose the custom settings instead, and set Privacy Display to activate only for notifications or certain apps.

snippet.title: How to get the most from your Hi-Fi sound | Galaxy Buds4 Pro | Samsung
snippet.description:
This is the official video guide on how to set up and personalize audio settings for a full Hi-Fi sound experience with Galaxy Buds4 Pro. Discover how to elevate your listening experience by enabling 'Ultra high quality (UHQ) audio', using adaptive Equalizer, and experiencing clearer calls with Super Clear Call. This guide also shows you how to further customize your sound with the 9-band Equalizer, immerse yourself in spatial audio with '360 audio', and optimize your listening environment with enhanced adaptive Active Noise Canceling. From achieving a proper earbud fit, to exploring advanced sound settings in One UI, you’ll be guided through simple steps designed to unlock clearer detail, improved sound clarity, and a more fine-tuned listening experience whether you’re enjoying music, watching videos, or taking calls. Learn more: http://smsng.co/Buds4Pro_Hi-Fi_How-to_yt

00:00 Intro
00:10 Easy Pairing
00:30 Wearing the earbuds
01:45 Advanced sound settings

Follow these steps to get the most out of your Hi-Fi sound on Galaxy Buds4 Pro:
Wearing the earbuds
Step 1: Insert the earbuds comfortably in your ears.
Step 2: Once the fit is detected, you’ll hear a brief sound feedback.
Step 3: Run a fit test in your Galaxy Buds settings to check your fit.
Step 4: Adjust if needed until you get a ‘Good fit’.
Advanced sound settings 
Step 1: Go to your Galaxy Buds settings.
Step 2: In 'Sound quality and effects', you can set features like '360 audio', and the Equalizer.
Step 3: In 'Advanced quality options', you can enable 'Ultra high quality (UHQ) audio' and 'Super wide band speech'.

Q: What is Advanced 2-way speaker?
A: Galaxy Buds4 Pro features the Advanced 2-way speaker system. The system includes a wider woofer and a tweeter, each handling tailored frequency ranges to reproduce sound as originally intended with minimum distortion. The new wider woofer with a 19.8 % larger diaphragm than Galaxy Buds3 Pro, delivers natural, high-quality bass, while precise tuning maintains phase coherence for unified Hi-Fi sound. And independent dual amplifiers ensure clarity, rich mids, and solid bass. 
Q: What is the Samsung Seamless Codec (SSC) ‘Ultra high quality (UHQ) audio’ option?
A: The ‘Ultra high quality (UHQ) audio' option supports 24-bit / 96 kHz audio with eligible Samsung Galaxy devices. It preserves the original sound with vast amount of information while maintaining stable connections.
Q: What is Super Clear Call?
A: Super Clear Call enhances voice clarity during calls, even in noisy environments. A machine-learned Deep Neural Network (DNN) reduces background noise and focuses on your voice.

snippet.title: How to access Galaxy AI features | Galaxy S26 Series | Samsung
snippet.description:
Discover how to access Galaxy AI features on the Galaxy S26 Series to transform your daily routine. This official guide shows you how to use Galaxy AI to streamline tasks, from editing photos with Photo Assist to getting smart suggestions via Now Nudge. Whether you are using the 7.2mm slim Galaxy S26 or the 6.7-inch Galaxy S26+, these tools make your mobile experience more personal and productive. 🚀 Learn more: http://smsng.co/S26_Galaxy-AI_How-to_yt

00:00 Intro
00:18 How to explore the new Galaxy AI features
00:46 How to access Photo Assist for AI editing
01:22 How to access Creative Studio for stickers
01:54 How to access Now Nudge for smart suggestions

Follow these steps to easily use Galaxy AI features:
Step 1: How to access Galaxy AI settings: Open the Quick Panel and tap ‘Settings’. Select ‘Galaxy AI’ to explore the new and improved Galaxy AI features.
Step 2: How to access Photo Assist: Open ‘Gallery’ on your home screen and select a photo. Tap ‘Galaxy AI’, then ‘Create’, and use the prompt bar to describe your vision. Tap ‘Generate’ and let Galaxy AI bring your 50MP Wide camera shots to life with AI-driven edits.
Step 3: How to access Creative Studio: Swipe up for the apps screen or use the Edge panel to open ‘Creative Studio’. Tap the Style icon to generate custom sticker sets from your sketches or descriptions, then share them instantly via Quick Share.
Step 4: How to access Now Nudge: Navigate to ‘Settings’ via the Quick Panel and tap ‘Galaxy AI’. Select ‘Now Nudge’ and toggle it on to receive intelligent shortcuts based on your screen context, like instant photo sharing suggestions.

Q: Do I need a Samsung Account to access Galaxy AI features?
A: Yes. To access Galaxy AI features like Photo Assist and Creative Studio, a Samsung Account login and a network connection are required. This also ensures your personal data is protected by Samsung Knox.
Q: What new Galaxy AI features can I access on the Galaxy S26 Series?
A: The Galaxy S26 Series introduces Now Nudge, which recognizes screen context to offer smart suggestions. You can also access Photo Assist for prompt-based photo editing.
Q: Which messaging apps are supported by Now Nudge?
A: Text message prompts are currently available with Samsung Messages and select third-party messaging apps, including Google Messages and Google Chat. Supported apps may vary by market, carrier and launch timing, and are subject to change without notice.
